title: The Anatomy of an Instruction Pipeline Hazard
summary: A technical deep-dive into instruction pipeline hazards in CPU architecture, explaining the different types of hazards (data, structural, and control) that occur when instructions are processed in parallel through a processor pipeline, along with detection and resolution techniques.
problem_solved: Pipeline hazards cause incorrect instruction execution when parallel processing leads to data races, resource conflicts, and branch mispredictions in CPU cores.
why_valuable: Essential knowledge for understanding modern CPU design, optimizing compiler construction, and writing performant low-level code that respects hardware behavior.
